heck: an informal exclamation used to express surprise, annoyance, or emphasis
mega: very large or impressive in scale or degree
pre: a prefix meaning before or earlier than
onboard: relating to bringing a new employee or member into an organization
videogame: an electronic game played by interacting with images on a screen
outdate: to make something obsolete or no longer current
ice-cream: a sweet frozen dessert made with milk or cream
impassion: to fill someone with strong emotion or enthusiasm
goodnight: an expression used when saying goodbye at night or before sleep
dis: to insult or speak disrespectfully about someone
multi: a prefix meaning many or more than one
